messages.subject: Nelder-Mead
parts:
Hello,

I have a question about comparing parameters of models that use different methods. I ran into errors (nlm code 3) and using method = "Nelder-Mead" remedies these errors. secr documentation states that AIC values can be compared across methods. Can I also compare fitted parameter values across methods? Running the same data and model structure, I get slightly different values for density, lambda0, and sigma with and without method = "Nelder-Mead."

Thanks for your insight,
Annie

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Nelder-Mead
parts:
Yes - the numerical maximisation method is not material so long as it has worked (i.e. found the maximum). Minor numerical variation is to be expected. Your 'slightly different values' presumably falls in this basket. If estimates are genuinely unstable then extra care is needed - perhaps the model is not identifiable with the data you have (e.g. because it is too complex).
Murray
